purpose: Define WebRTC as the peer-to-peer transport binding used by DWH and messaging where configured, keeping peer semantic identity separate from transient ICE/session/channel state.

topics.name: WebRTC Peer Transport
topics.purpose: Define WebRTC as the peer-to-peer transport binding used by DWH and messaging where configured, keeping peer semantic identity separate from transient ICE/session/channel state.

semantics.identity_rule: Peer semantic identity is explicit and independent from ICE candidate, DTLS/SRTP session or data-channel identifier.
semantics.p2p_rule: Application payload path is peer-to-peer after successful establishment.
semantics.channel_rule: Data channels are transient transport resources.
semantics.authority_rule: Successful WebRTC establishment does not grant application data or operation authority.

invariants.rule: Transport session, cryptographic material, signaling metadata and semantic identity remain separate; secure transport never implies application authorization.

hard_gates.condition: ICE/session id used as semantic peer identity
signaling relay treated as default payload path
peer identity inferred solely from network endpoint

references.purpose: Messaging may use WebRTC peer transport.
DWH may use WebRTC for remote payload transport.
